summary: Arvana Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Settlement Agreement with J.P. Carey Enterprises to resolve $188,379 in past-due claims through the issuance of common stock under Section 3(a)(10) of the Securities Act. Shares are issued in tranches to generate net proceeds with a 40% discount retained by JPCarey; additional 250,000 shares cover legal fees. No fixed share count or price-per-share is stated. A court approved the settlement on April 11, 2026, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap per tranche. Watch for potential dilution and the ability to raise proceeds given the variable share pricing and market conditions.
